metric_definitions.views: Current YouTube documentation counts playback starts across formats beginning 2026-08-24.
metric_definitions.average_view_duration: Engaged views and their corresponding watch time; do not divide general watch time by all playback starts to reproduce this metric.
metric_definitions.ctr: Registered thumbnail impressions and corresponding engagement; not all channel views.
metric_definitions.monthly_audience: Estimated unique viewers over the rolling 28-day audience window.
metric_definitions.subscriber_status_shares: Watch-time shares, not audience or subscriber-count shares.

engaged_views.reason: Not explicitly displayed in supplied screenshots.

audience_behavior.interpretation_note: This three-segment card corresponds to new/casual/regular behavior. Do not equate its third segment with the separate returning-viewer metric. Regular/frequent viewers require repeated monthly viewing over more than six months.

video_retention_observations.note: Single displayed episode. Not channel-average retention and not proof of retention on October 7 productions.

realtime_observations.note: Separate rolling window; do not sum with main-window totals or earlier video-grid counts.

unavailable_data: Complete per-video impressions and CTR split by traffic source
Complete per-video retention curves and engaged-view counts
Other channels and videos watched by this audience
Detailed per-video device and subscriber-status breakdowns
limitations: Manual transcription of supplied screenshots; no authenticated Analytics query or CSV export was performed.
Screenshot capture timestamps are unknown; the analysis date is not an invented capture timestamp.
Displayed values may be rounded and different cards may have different windows or populations.
Main reports end on October 6 and do not evaluate the consorcio produced on October 7.
Observed performance is not causal attribution to titles, thumbnails, voice, renderer or topic.
Missing values remain null; no absent retention curve or video ID was fabricated.
